desc:
Welcome to the night crew at Blackridge Storage.

🛠️ Blackridge Storage is currently in Beta. Bugs may still occur, and we’ll continue fixing issues and improving the game as they’re reported.

Your shift runs from 9 PM to 5 AM. Clean assigned storage units, dispose of trash, mop up messes, maintain the facility, and keep the lights on until morning.

It should be an easy job.

Just remember:
Keep the facility clean.
Keep the power running.
And if you hear something down the hall... keep moving.

🎧 Headphones recommended for the best experience.
✨ High graphics recommended for the full Blackridge experience.
📼 Multiplayer Horror
🧹 Clean and maintain storage units
🛒 Work together with your night crew
🔦 Survive until the end of your shift
⚠️ Photosensitivity Warning: This game contains flashing lights and visual effects that may affect players with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitivities.

All music used in Blackridge Storage is original or properly licensed for use.
